title: TD 100 experiment on a woman on film

plain: Silent film footage from the early 1960s shows an experiment carried out on a woman at Intelectron, a company in New York City, according to the researcher Greg Malatzi. In his account the woman sits behind a wall in one room while the experimenters are in another with the TD 100, a device their inventor built in the early 1960s, and although there is no sound, Malatzi says "it's obvious what's happening." He describes the footage himself without naming where it came from, and tells it as a sign that the device could affect a person through a wall.
